skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 2 consecutive strikes, dealing 800% ATK DMG. The last attack has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Collapse] on 3 random enemies for 3 turns. Also has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Disable] on 3 random enemies for 2 rounds. [Specialized Collapse]: Decreases DMG Free by 10%. When attacked, deals 250% of Flashy Flash’s ATK as DMG. Stacks up to 3 times and does not stack with [Shatter]. [Specialized Disable]: Prevents Follow-Ups and Combo Follow-Ups, and reduces DMG Rate%.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 2 consecutive strikes, dealing 1000% ATK DMG. The last attack has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Collapse] on 3 random enemies for 3 turns. Also has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Disable] on all enemies for 2 rounds. [Specialized Collapse]: Decreases DMG Free by 15%. When attacked, deals 350% of Flashy Flash’s ATK as DMG. Stacks up to 3 times and does not stack with [Shatter]. [Specialized Disable]: Prevents Follow-Ups and Combo Follow-Ups, and reduces DMG Rate by 40%.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, gains 60% [Instant DMG Evasion] and [Specialized Acceleration]. Immune to [Specialized Disable] and [Adhesion]. [Instant DMG Evasion]: Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG only deal 1 point of DMG. [Specialized Acceleration]: Increases own Speed by 30%.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, gains 70% [Instant DMG Evasion] and [Specialized Acceleration]. Immune to [Specialized Disable] and [Adhesion]. [Instant DMG Evasion]: Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG only deal 1 point of DMG. [Specialized Acceleration]: Increases own Speed by 34%.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, gains 80% [Instant DMG Evasion] and [Specialized Acceleration]. Immune to [Specialized Disable] and [Adhesion]. [Instant DMG Evasion]: Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG only deal 1 point of DMG. [Specialized Acceleration]: Increases own Speed by 38%.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: After any enemy takes action, if their Speed is lower than Flashy Flash’s Speed, launches an [Ultimate Follow-Up]. Before any character takes action, launches an [Ultimate Follow-Up], once per round. [Ultimate Follow-Up]: Deals 70% of the Ultimate’s DMG. Can trigger up to 3 times per round.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: After any enemy takes action, if their Speed is lower than Flashy Flash’s Speed, launches an [Ultimate Follow-Up]. Before any character takes action, launches an [Ultimate Follow-Up], once per round. [Ultimate Follow-Up]: Deals 100% of the Ultimate’s DMG. Can trigger up to 5 times per round.

effects.desc: Status that causes the bearer to be unaffected by a certain effect or type of control, such as [Breakthrough], Stun, or Charm.
Speed ​​buff that while in effect allows the bearer and up to 6 allies to act against and overcome enemies with lower speed.
Disabled status applies to a target area/column, rendering affected units unable to act or be effective.
